newsitem.title: UK: Staveley warns on profits, shares drop.
newsitem.headline: Staveley warns on profits, shares drop.

text.p: British engineering group Staveley Industries Plc said on Thursday it expected profits for the year to March 29, 1997 to be lower than the 23.2 million stg profit posted in the previous year.
"Staveley expects profits before tax to be close to but not to exceed the pretax profit...achieved in the prior year," the company said in a statement.
It attributed the forecast to a worse than expected result from Chronos Richardson's bagging systems business and a number of "unsatisfactory" contracts in Italy and Germany.
Staveley shares were 33p lower at 153-1/2p at 0831 GMT.
Staveley said Chronos Richardson was also hit by rising competition and the strong pound. Orders and margins were adversely affected, it added.
Staveley said it had made management changes to the bagging systems business and focused on efficiency programmes.
